title: Extremely Deceptive Company
body:
clickup is an extremely dishonest company.

their entire pricing structure is one big bait and switch scheme to try to get you to upgrade. they say pricing is transparent but it is anything but.

they give you free forever but then you have to upgrade and then you pay for your entire team to upgrade for unlimited but what you find is unlimited is extremely limited. with every upgrade you cannot select specific team members to receive that upgrade. you have to upgrade for everybody on your team.

additionally they say you get two free members and tell you to send the invites out to your team. upon research i found that this is totally false. the only way that you can invite two free members is if they are only viewers. they don't tell you that. they just automatically add it to your bill without any notice.

then features that you're used to such as the audio/ai transcription for the chat they allow you to use it and then revoke it with no notice.

we are actively looking for an alternate platform to switch to because of these deceptive dishonest bait and switch tactics. 

shame on you clickup. i'm also filing reports on you to the app store
for these deceptive practices. look at Reddit, ClickUp, you guys are permanently tarnishing your reputation.

title: Run away
body:
Update 4/26: RUN and find another option. This was a great system and has just continued to get more bugs in the mobile and desktop versions. It’s completely unreliable for dates in all tasks, now, instead of primarily having issues with recurring tasks. I stuck with it because of promised improvements and because I have thousands of tasks in it, but it’s become nearly useless. My best advice — just don’t. You’ll spend less time on programs that have fewer supposed bells and whistles than you will on constantly looking for missing tasks in ClickUp. You also won’t get any follow through on bug reports — they still haven’t addressed the issue I reported 3 years ago. 

I’ve loved ClickUp since I started using it a few years ago. I had faith that some annoying bugs would get squashed, eventually, and it would become the absolute best tool I’d found for managing my workload and other projects. Unfortunately, a bug with recurring tasks not regenerating correctly STILL hasn’t been fixed after more than a year. I spend so much time checking to see what my filtered views are missing because tasks didn’t regenerate correctly and correcting statuses that I’m starting to look for less capable but more reliable options. ClickUp should be helping streamline my work, not adding to it.

title: Hot garbage for tablet users
body: I use ClickUp every single day for two different businesses and I bought an iPad so that I would be able to work when away from my desk/computer. I pay for it, and it’s something that I genuinely have never had an issue with on a desktop or even my phone, but nothing I have done has worked on this tablet. I have downloaded, removed, re-downloaded, tried using it in Safari, tried using it in Chrome, everything. It “requires iOS 16.4 or later” - my brand new iPad is completely up to date but the app doesn’t let me get past the error pages stating I need to update the app. I’ve tried accessing and signing in using a browser; the second I hit “Log In”, I’m redirected to the “Sign Up” page. I have completely wiped and reset my iPad, thinking that would fix it, but it’s the same garbage every time. ClickUp works great on desktop. It even works on my phone. But to be paying for a platform and not even being able to find a work-around is the most infuriating experience, I’m contemplating just finding a completely new software for myself and my team. If you only need to utilize ClickUp on a desktop or laptop, it’s fine, but the fact that you can’t use the app or even try to work around that and use it in a browser is absolutely insane.

title: Removed the chat button
body:
I’m a click up power user and I primarily use the desktop app

But I loved using the mobile app for managing chats with my team 

Having the dedicated chat button on the bottom of the navigation bar made a lot of sense why click up in their infinite wisdom decided to bury it behind a home screen Makes no sense

Now I have to click a bunch of extra buttons just to get to my chats 

Click up some advice and I hope you listen 

I know you have a lot of features that you have to manage and I’m sure trying to become the everything app is difficult When supporting so many different functionalities

I really commend your vision and your goal and I support it financially Every month when we renew our subscription, sure many other customers would feel the same way

But please understand that when you try to serve everyone you are going to run the risk of serving no one 

Perhaps a easy compromise would be stop, forcing UI changes on your users. Instead, only make forced UI changes when it’s an overall net positive for all us

For things like main navigation and quick access buttons, let users customize what button buttons they want instead of do it this way you can continue your goals as building the everything app but you don’t isolate your user basis for people who don’t want to use it the way you want them to use it for a company like mine I’m managing team members and I have to be engaged on live chat. The power of “mirroring” tasks across different lists, unified statuses and clean and friendly layout of their tasks and subtasks makes it king.

At first I hated the mobile app, but I realize it has great functionality.

It could be simplified and have an offline mode that queues info for synch like Trello, but overall it gets the job done very well across running small teams and allows you to do so much other platforms can’t.

title: Do NOT get an annual plan!
body: You can tell a lot about a company when looking at how easy it is to cancel their service. With ClickUp it’s near impossible. They hide the buttons and force you to complete multiple forms to ‘downgrade’ your plan. Want a refund for 10 months of unused service for your entire team on you business plan? Forget about it! They are plain deceptive and evil when it comes to billing related issues. Want to know if you’re being charged for a “guest” a “member” or “limited member” on your account and how much? Saddle up for at least half an hour of agonizing frustration to try to untangle the word salad they have that “explains” how they will charge you without your knowledge, that then their “100% satisfaction guarantee” will not cover.  We were with these goons for three years, every single year they jumble the buttons and say the features that you actually need are “coming soon”. Stay away from ClickUp unless you’re in need of frustration, disappointment, and unnecessary headaches and getting scammed in your life.

title: Exceeded Expectations
body:
I downloaded this app over a year ago but found it difficult to use, so I stopped. Instead, I continued using the desktop version. Today, I decided to give the app another try—and I was blown away by the improvements.

The navigation is now incredibly user-friendly. I can easily view and manage tasks that are overdue, due soon, or upcoming. Adding new tasks to my lists is seamless, making the app feel intuitive and efficient.

I instantly knew this was going to be a game changer. While I’ve been using ClickUp, I’ve never fully taken advantage of it because it’s only accessible when I’m at my work computer. Now, with this easy-to-use app, my productivity will skyrocket. I’m confident I’ll be able to stay on top of important tasks wherever I am.
